map.玻尔兹曼布居比 N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE ÷ (k_B×T))，ΔE 由 e: Boltzmann population ratio N₂/N₁ = e^(−ΔE ÷ (k_B×T)), with ΔE converted from eV to joules by ×1.602176634×10⁻¹⁹ (k_B = 1.380649×10⁻²³ J/K); upper-level share = ratio ÷ (1+ratio) × 100%, lower-level share = 1 ÷ (1+ratio) × 100%. Validation: non-empty numeric guards for ΔE and T. Criteria: a larger ΔE or lower T makes the upper-level share decay exponentially.
